title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 18 · Biography of Zang Ba · with Sun Guan

text.en: When his father Zang Jie was seized for defying an unjust execution order, eighteen-year-old Zang Ba led retainers to rescue him, becoming known for his bravery.
text.zht: 父親臧戒因拒行不義之殺令而被捕，十八歲的臧霸率部曲將他救出，因而以勇烈聞名。
text.zhs: 父亲臧戒因拒行不义之杀令而被捕，十八岁的臧霸率部曲将他救出，因而以勇烈闻名。

text.en: Zang Ba followed Tao Qian in defeating the Yellow Turbans and was appointed Commandant of Cavalry.
text.zht: 臧霸隨陶謙擊破黃巾軍，獲拜騎都尉。
text.zhs: 臧霸随陶谦击破黄巾军，获拜骑都尉。

text.en: Zang Ba, Sun Guan, Wu Dun, Yin Li, and others gathered their followers together at Kaiyang under Zang Ba's leadership, and later all surrendered to Cao Cao together.
text.zht: 臧霸與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等聚眾屯於開陽，以霸為帥，後一同歸降曹操。
text.zhs: 臧霸与孙观、吴敦、尹礼等聚众屯于开阳，以霸为帅，后一同归降曹操。

text.en: Zang Ba, Sun Guan, Wu Dun, Yin Li, and others gathered their followers together at Kaiyang under Zang Ba's leadership, and later all surrendered to Cao Cao together.
text.zht: 臧霸與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等聚眾屯於開陽，以霸為帥，後一同歸降曹操。
text.zhs: 臧霸与孙观、吴敦、尹礼等聚众屯于开阳，以霸为帅，后一同归降曹操。

text.en: Zang Ba, Sun Guan, Wu Dun, Yin Li, and others gathered their followers together at Kaiyang under Zang Ba's leadership, and later all surrendered to Cao Cao together.
text.zht: 臧霸與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等聚眾屯於開陽，以霸為帥，後一同歸降曹操。
text.zhs: 臧霸与孙观、吴敦、尹礼等聚众屯于开阳，以霸为帅，后一同归降曹操。

text.en: Sun Kang was Sun Guan's elder brother; both surrendered to Cao Cao together and were made Grand Administrators.
text.zht: 孫康是孫觀之兄，二人一同歸降曹操，皆獲任太守。
text.zhs: 孙康是孙观之兄，二人一同归降曹操，皆获任太守。

text.en: When Cao Cao campaigned against Lü Bu, Zang Ba and the others led troops to assist him; after Lü Bu's capture, Zang Ba went into hiding.
text.zht: 曹操征討呂布時，臧霸等率兵相助；呂布被擒後，臧霸潛逃隱匿。
text.zhs: 曹操征讨吕布时，臧霸等率兵相助；吕布被擒后，臧霸潜逃隐匿。

text.en: Cao Cao, delighted to find Zang Ba after his capture of Lü Bu, had him persuade his former comrades to surrender, then made him Chancellor of Langya, entrusting him with the two provinces of Qing and Xu.
text.zht: 曹操於呂布事平後尋得臧霸，見而喜悅，令其招降舊部，遂以霸為琅邪相，並將青、徐二州委任於他。
text.zhs: 曹操于吕布事平后寻得臧霸，见而喜悦，令其招降旧部，遂以霸为琅邪相，并将青、徐二州委任于他。

text.en: When Cao Cao ordered Zang Ba to hand over two defectors who had sought refuge with him, Zang Ba appealed through Liu Bei rather than comply directly; Cao Cao was pleased by his courage to uphold what he owed them, and spared both men.
text.zht: 曹操命臧霸交出投奔他的徐翕、毛暉二人，臧霸不願直接從命，轉託劉備代為說情；曹操讚賞其守義之勇，遂赦免二人。
text.zhs: 曹操命臧霸交出投奔他的徐翕、毛晖二人，臧霸不愿直接从命，转托刘备代为说情；曹操赞赏其守义之勇，遂赦免二人。

text.en: As Zang Ba's repeated strikes into Qing Province let Cao Cao focus fully on Yuan Shao, and after Cao Cao graciously declined his offer to send kinsmen as hostages to Ye, Zang Ba was enfeoffed Capital Neighbourhood Marquis and made General Who Awes the Enemies for pacifying the region between Mount Tai and the Bohai Sea.
text.zht: 臧霸屢以精兵入青州牽制，使曹操得以專心對付袁紹；曹操又婉拒其遣子弟為質於鄴之請。臧霸等平定泰山、渤海一帶，功勳卓著，獲封都亭侯，加威虜將軍。
text.zhs: 臧霸屡以精兵入青州牵制，使曹操得以专心对付袁绍；曹操又婉拒其遣子弟为质于邺之请。臧霸等平定泰山、渤海一带，功勋卓著，获封都亭侯，加威虏将军。

title.en: Capital Neighbourhood Marquis, General Who Awes the Enemies

text.en: After campaigning with Yu Jin against Chang Xi and with Xiahou Yuan against Yellow Turban remnants, Zang Ba was promoted to Inspector of Xu Province.
text.zht: 臧霸與于禁討昌豨，又與夏侯淵討黃巾餘賊，因功升任徐州刺史。
text.zhs: 臧霸与于禁讨昌豨，又与夏侯渊讨黄巾余贼，因功升任徐州刺史。

text.en: When Zang Ba stopped Zhang Liao from a premature retreat during the Ruxukou campaign, correctly trusting that Cao Cao would not abandon them, Cao Cao praised his judgement and appointed him General Who Promotes Might and Provisional Bearer of the Tally.
text.zht: 濡須口之役，臧霸勸阻張遼勿倉促撤退，深信曹操不會棄之不顧；曹操聞後讚許其識見，拜揚威將軍，假節。
text.zhs: 濡须口之役，臧霸劝阻张辽勿仓促撤退，深信曹操不会弃之不顾；曹操闻后赞许其识见，拜扬威将军，假节。

title.en: General Who Promotes Might, Provisional Bearer of the Tally

text.en: When the fugitive defector Xu Xi sought refuge with him, Zang Ba refused to hand him over even at Cao Cao's order, appealing through Liu Bei instead; Cao Cao ultimately spared and reappointed him.
text.zht: 叛將徐翕逃來投奔，臧霸即使曹操下令索取亦不肯交出，轉託劉備代為說情；曹操最終赦免並重新任用他。
text.zhs: 叛将徐翕逃来投奔，臧霸即使曹操下令索取亦不肯交出，转托刘备代为说情；曹操最终赦免并重新任用他。

text.en: Zang Ba sheltered the fugitive Mao Hui and refused to hand him over even at Cao Cao's order, appealing through Liu Bei instead; Cao Cao ultimately spared and reappointed him.
text.zht: 臧霸庇護亡命的毛暉，即使曹操下令索取亦不肯交出，轉託劉備代為說情；曹操最終赦免並重新任用他。
text.zhs: 臧霸庇护亡命的毛晖，即使曹操下令索取亦不肯交出，转托刘备代为说情；曹操最终赦免并重新任用他。

text.en: At Zang Ba's request, Liu Bei relayed his appeal to Cao Cao on behalf of the two fugitives he sheltered, which Cao Cao ultimately granted.
text.zht: 應臧霸所託，劉備將他為所庇二人求情之言轉告曹操，曹操最終應允。
text.zhs: 应臧霸所托，刘备将他为所庇二人求情之言转告曹操，曹操最终应允。

text.en: Zang Ba joined Yu Jin in campaigning against Chang Xi.
text.zht: 臧霸與于禁共同討伐昌豨。
text.zhs: 臧霸与于禁共同讨伐昌豨。

text.en: Zang Ba joined Xiahou Yuan in campaigning against Yellow Turban remnants under Xu He.
text.zht: 臧霸與夏侯淵共同討伐黃巾餘賊徐和等。
text.zhs: 臧霸与夏侯渊共同讨伐黄巾余贼徐和等。

text.en: Zang Ba respected and admired Wu Zhou, Prefect of Xiapi, personally visiting his residence, and esteemed him all the more after Wu Zhou justly prosecuted a corrupt aide.
text.zht: 臧霸敬重下邳令武周，親自登門拜訪；後武周秉公查辦不法的部從事，臧霸因此更加敬佩他。
text.zhs: 臧霸敬重下邳令武周，亲自登门拜访；后武周秉公查办不法的部从事，臧霸因此更加敬佩他。

text.en: Zang Ba joined the campaign against Sun Quan, leading the vanguard, and advanced into Chao Lake to capture Juchao.
text.zht: 臧霸隨軍討伐孫權，為先登，後進入巢湖攻取居巢。
text.zhs: 臧霸随军讨伐孙权，为先登，后进入巢湖攻取居巢。

text.en: While Zhang Liao campaigned against Chen Lan, Zang Ba was separately dispatched to defeat the Wu general Han Dang and cut off relief, enabling Zhang Liao's victory.
text.zht: 張遼征討陳蘭時，臧霸奉命另擊吳將韓當，斷絕援軍，使張遼得以獲勝。
text.zhs: 张辽征讨陈兰时，臧霸奉命另击吴将韩当，断绝援军，使张辽得以获胜。

text.en: Serving as vanguard together with Zhang Liao at Ruxukou, Zang Ba talked him out of a premature retreat, correctly trusting that Cao Cao would not abandon them.
text.zht: 濡須口之役，臧霸與張遼同為前鋒，勸阻其倉促撤退，深信曹操不會棄之不顧。
text.zhs: 濡须口之役，臧霸与张辽同为前锋，劝阻其仓促撤退，深信曹操不会弃之不顾。

text.en: Zang Ba fought and defeated Han Dang at Fenglong and Jiashi, cutting off his relief of Chen Lan.
text.zht: 臧霸於逢龍、夾石等地擊敗韓當，斷絕其對陳蘭的救援。
text.zhs: 臧霸于逢龙、夹石等地击败韩当，断绝其对陈兰的救援。

text.en: After Sun Quan sought to surrender and Cao Cao withdrew, Zang Ba remained with Xiahou Dun and others to garrison Juchao.
text.zht: 孫權求降、曹操撤軍後，臧霸與夏侯惇等留守居巢。
text.zhs: 孙权求降、曹操撤军后，臧霸与夏侯惇等留守居巢。

text.en: When Cao Pi succeeded as King of Wei, Zang Ba was promoted General Who Garrisons the East, advanced to Wu'an Township Marquis, and made Commander of all military affairs in Qing Province; upon Cao Pi's enthronement, he was further enfeoffed Marquis of Kaiyang, then reassigned Marquis of Liangcheng.
text.zht: 文帝即王位，臧霸升任鎮東將軍，進爵武安鄉侯，都督青州諸軍事；及踐阼，進封開陽侯，後徙封良成侯。
text.zhs: 文帝即王位，臧霸升任镇东将军，进爵武安乡侯，都督青州诸军事；及践阼，进封开阳侯，后徙封良成侯。

title.en: General Who Garrisons the East, Wu'an Township Marquis, Marquis of Kaiyang, Marquis of Liangcheng
title.zht: 鎮東將軍、武安鄉侯、開陽侯、良成侯
title.zhs: 镇东将军、武安乡侯、开阳侯、良成侯

text.en: When Cao Cao died, Zang Ba's troops beat their drums and departed without orders; Cao Pi, already suspicious of him for this, grew more so when Zang Ba boasted to Cao Xiu of what he could achieve with more troops, and stripped him of his command.
text.zht: 曹操去世時，臧霸部眾擅自擊鼓離營；文帝因此心生猜疑，後臧霸又向曹休誇言若予重兵可如何建功，文帝疑心更甚，遂奪其兵權。
text.zhs: 曹操去世时，臧霸部众擅自击鼓离营；文帝因此心生猜疑，后臧霸又向曹休夸言若予重兵可如何建功，文帝疑心更甚，遂夺其兵权。

text.en: After joining Cao Xiu to defeat Lü Fan at Dongpu, Zang Ba was summoned to the capital as Bearer of the Golden Mace, ranked Specially Advanced, and the Emperor regularly sought his counsel on military affairs.
text.zht: 臧霸與曹休討吳，於洞浦擊破呂範，其後被徵召入朝任執金吾，位特進，每逢軍事，帝常向他諮詢。
text.zhs: 臧霸与曹休讨吴，于洞浦击破吕范，其后被征召入朝任执金吾，位特进，每逢军事，帝常向他咨询。

title.en: Bearer of the Golden Mace, Specially Advanced

text.en: When Zang Ba died, he was posthumously honoured as Marquis Wei, the Formidable Marquis; across his career, three of his sons were enfeoffed as marquises and one granted Marquis Within the Pass.
text.zht: 臧霸去世，追諡威侯；其一生功勳，使三子封侯，一子獲賜關內侯。
text.zhs: 臧霸去世，追谥威侯；其一生功勋，使三子封侯，一子获赐关内侯。

text.en: Zang Ba joined Cao Xiu in campaigning against Wu, defeating Lü Fan at Dongpu.
text.zht: 臧霸與曹休共同討伐東吳，於洞浦擊破呂範。
text.zhs: 臧霸与曹休共同讨伐东吴，于洞浦击破吕范。

text.en: Zang Ai was Zang Ba's son, who succeeded him and rose to become Inspector of Qing Province and Minister of the Lesser Treasury.
text.zht: 臧艾是臧霸之子，承襲其位，後官至青州刺史、少府。
text.zhs: 臧艾是臧霸之子，承袭其位，后官至青州刺史、少府。

text.en: Zang Quan succeeded his father Zang Ai, who was posthumously honoured as Marquis Gong.
text.zht: 臧艾去世後追諡恭侯，子臧權嗣位。
text.zhs: 臧艾去世后追谥恭侯，子臧权嗣位。

text.en: Zang Shun, courtesy name Taibo, was Zang Ba's other son, who under the Jin became Cavalier Regular Attendant.
text.zht: 臧舜字太伯，是臧霸另一子，入晉後官至散騎常侍。
text.zhs: 臧舜字太伯，是臧霸另一子，入晋后官至散骑常侍。

text.en: Sun Yu succeeded his father Sun Guan and likewise rose to become Inspector of Qing Province.
text.zht: 孫觀去世後，子孫毓嗣位，同樣官至青州刺史。
text.zhs: 孙观去世后，子孙毓嗣位，同样官至青州刺史。

text.en: Sun Guan rose to become Inspector of Qing Province and Provisional Bearer of the Tally, and followed Cao Cao in campaigning against Sun Quan, where he was wounded in battle and died.
text.zht: 孫觀官至青州刺史，假節，隨曹操征討孫權，於陣中負傷而死。
text.zhs: 孙观官至青州刺史，假节，随曹操征讨孙权，于阵中负伤而死。

orig.zht: 臧霸字宣高，[[泰山華|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人也。父戒，為縣獄掾，據法不聽[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]欲所私殺。[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，令收戒詣府，時送者百餘人。霸年十八，將客數十人徑於[[費|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]西山中要奪之，送者莫敢動，因與父俱亡命[[東海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]，由是以勇壯聞。
orig.zhs: 臧霸字宣高，[[泰山华|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人也。父戒，为县狱掾，据法不听[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]欲所私杀。[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，令收戒诣府，时送者百余人。霸年十八，将客数十人径于[[费|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]西山中要夺之，送者莫敢动，因与父俱亡命[[东海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]，由是以勇壮闻。

vern.zht: 臧霸，字宣高，是[[泰山郡華縣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人。父親臧戒擔任縣裏的獄掾，依法不肯聽從[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]徇私殺人的意願。[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，下令將臧戒逮捕押送到郡府，當時押送的人有一百多人。臧霸十八歲，帶着幾十名門客徑直在[[費|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]縣西邊的山中攔截，奪回父親；押送的人沒有誰敢動。於是他和父親一起逃到[[東海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]郡，從此以勇壯聞名。
vern.zhs: 臧霸，字宣高，是[[泰山郡华县|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]人。父亲臧戒担任县里的狱掾，依法不肯听从[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]徇私杀人的意愿。[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]大怒，下令将臧戒逮捕押送到郡府，当时押送的人有一百多人。臧霸十八岁，带着几十名门客径直在[[费|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]]县西边的山中拦截，夺回父亲；押送的人没有谁敢动。于是他和父亲一起逃到[[东海|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=50]]郡，从此以勇壮闻名。

passages.en: Zang Ba, courtesy name Xuangao, was from [[Hua, Taishan|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.32124106&lng=118.18296699&name=Hua]]. His father, Zang Jie, served as a county prison administrator. Adhering to the law, he refused the [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]'s order to execute a man out of personal spite. The [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]], greatly enraged, ordered Zang Jie seized and brought to his headquarters, dispatching over a hundred men to escort him. Zang Ba, then eighteen, led several dozen retainers to intercept them directly in the hills west of [[Fei|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.35221866&lng=117.93768412&name=Fei]] and rescue his father. None of the escorts dared resist. He then fled into hiding at [[Donghai|/maps/map-overall?admin=50]] together with his father, and from this became known for his bravery and spirit.

orig.zht: 黃巾起，霸從陶謙擊破之，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。遂收兵於[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等並聚衆，霸為帥，屯於[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]。太祖之討呂布也，霸等將兵助布。旣禽布，霸自匿。太祖募索得霸，見而恱之，使霸招吳敦、尹禮、孫觀、觀兄康等，皆詣太祖。太祖以霸為[[琅邪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=51]][[相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，敦[[利城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]]、禮[[東莞|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=52]]、觀[[北海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=44]]、康[[城陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=45]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，割[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]二州，委之於霸。

vern.zht: 黃巾起事，臧霸跟隨陶謙擊破黃巾，被任命爲[[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。於是他在[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]收聚士兵，與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等人一起聚合部衆，臧霸任統帥，屯駐在[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]。太祖討伐呂布時，臧霸等人帶兵幫助呂布。太祖擒獲呂布後，臧霸自己躲藏起來。太祖懸賞搜捕，抓到了臧霸，見到後很喜歡他，讓臧霸招集吳敦、尹禮、孫觀、孫觀的哥哥孫康等人，他們都來見太祖。太祖任命臧霸爲[[琅邪|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=51]][[相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，任命吳敦爲[[利城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]、尹禮爲[[東莞|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=52]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]、孫觀爲[[北海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=44]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]、孫康爲[[城陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=45]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]；把[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]州、[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]二州劃出，交給臧霸治理。

passages.en: When the Yellow Turbans rose, Zang Ba followed Tao Qian in defeating them, and was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]. Zang Ba then raised troops in [[Xu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]], and together with Sun Guan, Wu Dun, Yin Li, and others, assembled a following under his leadership. They garrisoned at [[Kaiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]]. When Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) campaigned against Lü Bu, Zang Ba and the others led troops to assist Lü Bu. When Lü Bu was captured, Zang Ba went into hiding. Cao Cao searched for Zang Ba and was delighted when he was eventually found. Cao Cao had Zang Ba persuade Wu Dun, Yin Li, Sun Guan, and Sun Guan's elder brother, Sun Kang, to surrender, and all came to Cao Cao. Cao Cao made Zang Ba [[Chancellor|/translations/officials/regional#states-064]] of [[Langya|/maps/map-overall?admin=51]], and appointed Wu Dun to [[Licheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.84932865&lng=118.79955895&name=Licheng]], Yin Li to [[Dongguan|/maps/map-overall?admin=52]], Sun Guan to [[Beihai|/maps/map-overall?admin=44]], and Sun Kang to [[Chengyang|/maps/map-overall?admin=45]] as [[Grand Administrators|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]], entrusting to Zang ba the two provinces of [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]].

orig.zht: 太祖之在[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]，以徐翕、毛暉為將。[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]亂，翕、暉皆叛。後[[兖州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]定，翕、暉亡命投霸。太祖語劉備，令語霸送二人首。霸謂備曰：「霸所以能自立者，以不謂此也。霸受公生全之恩，不敢違命。然王霸之君可以義告，願將軍為之辭。」備以霸言白太祖，太祖歎息，謂霸曰：「此古人之事而君能行之，孤之願也。」乃皆以翕、暉為[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
orig.zhs: 太祖之在[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]，以徐翕、毛晖为将。[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]乱，翕、晖皆叛。后[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]定，翕、晖亡命投霸。太祖语刘备，令语霸送二人首。霸谓备曰：「霸所以能自立者，以不谓此也。霸受公生全之恩，不敢违命。然王霸之君可以义告，愿将军为之辞。」备以霸言白太祖，太祖叹息，谓霸曰：「此古人之事而君能行之，孤之愿也。」乃皆以翕、晖为[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

vern.zht: 太祖在[[兗州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]時，任用徐翕、毛暉爲將。[[兗州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]動亂，徐翕、毛暉都反叛了。後來[[兗州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]平定，徐翕、毛暉逃亡投奔臧霸。太祖告訴劉備，讓劉備傳話給臧霸，要臧霸把二人的首級送來。臧霸對劉備說：“我臧霸之所以能自立，就是因爲不做這種事。我蒙受曹公保全我性命的恩德，不敢違抗命令。然而推行王霸之業的君主，可以用道義去打動，希望將軍替我陳說。”劉備把臧霸的話稟告太祖，太祖嘆息，對臧霸說：“這是古人才能做到的事，您卻能實行它，這也正是我的心願。”於是把徐翕、毛暉都任命爲[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。
vern.zhs: 太祖在[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]时，任用徐翕、毛晖为将。[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]动乱，徐翕、毛晖都反叛了。后来[[兖州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]平定，徐翕、毛晖逃亡投奔臧霸。太祖告诉刘备，让刘备传话给臧霸，要臧霸把二人的首级送来。臧霸对刘备说：“我臧霸之所以能自立，就是因为不做这种事。我蒙受曹公保全我性命的恩德，不敢违抗命令。然而推行王霸之业的君主，可以用道义去打动，希望将军替我陈说。”刘备把臧霸的话禀告太祖，太祖叹息，对臧霸说：“这是古人才能做到的事，您却能实行它，这也正是我的心愿。”于是把徐翕、毛晖都任命为[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。

passages.en: When Cao Cao was in [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]], he made Xu Xi and Mao Hui generals. When [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]] fell into turmoil, both Xu Xi and Mao Hui turned traitor. After [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]] was later pacified, they fled to seek refuge with Zang Ba. Cao Cao told Liu Bei to have Zang Ba send back the two men's heads. Zang Ba said to Liu Bei, "The reason I have attained my present standing is that I would never do such a thing. I have received from His Excellency the grace of being spared and preserved, and dare not defy his command. Yet a ruler destined for greatness can be reasoned with through righteousness. I hope you, General, will speak on my behalf." Liu Bei relayed Zang Ba's words to Cao Cao, who sighed and said to Zang Ba, "This is a deed of the ancients, and that you had the courage to uphold it is precisely what I had hoped to see." He then made both Xu Xi and Mao Hui [[Grand Administrators|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]].

orig.zht: 時太祖方與袁紹相拒，而霸數以精兵入[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，故太祖得專事紹，不以東方為念。太祖破袁譚於[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，霸等會賀。霸因求遣子弟及諸將父兄家屬詣[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，太祖曰：「諸君忠孝，豈復在是！昔蕭何遣子弟入侍，而高祖不拒，耿純焚室輿櫬以從，而光武不逆，吾將何以易之哉！」東州擾攘，霸等執義征暴，清定海岱，功莫大焉，皆封[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。霸為[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加[[威虜將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。
orig.zhs: 时太祖方与袁绍相拒，而霸数以精兵入[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，故太祖得专事绍，不以东方为念。太祖破袁谭于[[南皮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]，霸等会贺。霸因求遣子弟及诸将父兄家属诣[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，太祖曰：「诸君忠孝，岂复在是！昔萧何遣子弟入侍，而高祖不拒，耿纯焚室舆榇以从，而光武不逆，吾将何以易之哉！」东州扰攘，霸等执义征暴，清定海岱，功莫大焉，皆封[[列侯|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。霸为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加[[威虏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。

vern.zht: 當時太祖正與袁紹相持，臧霸多次率精兵進入[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，因此太祖能夠專心對付袁紹，不把東方放在心上。太祖在[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]擊敗袁譚，臧霸等人聚會慶賀。臧霸乘機請求把自己的子弟和衆將的父兄家屬送到[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]城。太祖說：“諸位的忠孝，難道還要靠這件事來表現嗎！從前蕭何派遣子弟入朝侍奉，高祖沒有拒絕；耿純焚燒住宅、載着棺材跟隨，光武沒有阻攔，我又怎麼能改變這種做法呢！”東州動亂，臧霸等人秉持正義征討暴虐者，平定了海岱一帶，功勞沒有比這更大的，他們都被封爲[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。臧霸封爲[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加任[[威虜將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。
vern.zhs: 当时太祖正与袁绍相持，臧霸多次率精兵进入[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]，因此太祖能够专心对付袁绍，不把东方放在心上。太祖在[[南皮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]击败袁谭，臧霸等人聚会庆贺。臧霸乘机请求把自己的子弟和众将的父兄家属送到[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]城。太祖说：“诸位的忠孝，难道还要靠这件事来表现吗！从前萧何派遣子弟入朝侍奉，高祖没有拒绝；耿纯焚烧住宅、载着棺材跟随，光武没有阻拦，我又怎么能改变这种做法呢！”东州动乱，臧霸等人秉持正义征讨暴虐者，平定了海岱一带，功劳没有比这更大的，他们都被封为[[列侯|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。臧霸封为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，加任[[威虏将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]]。

passages.en: At the time, Cao Cao was locked in confrontation with Yuan Shao. As Zang Ba repeatedly launched attacks into [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] with elite troops, Cao Cao was free to devote his full attention to Yuan Shao without concern for the eastern front. When Cao Cao defeated Yuan Tan at [[Nanpi|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]], Zang Ba and the others gathered to congratulate. Zang Ba then asked to send his younger clansmen and the families of his generals to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]. Cao Cao said, "Your loyalty and filial devotion surely do not depend on this! In the past, Xiao He sent his younger kinsmen to serve at court, and Emperor Gaozu did not refuse them. Geng Chun burned down his home and brought along his own coffin to follow Emperor Guangwu, and Emperor Guangwu did not turn him away. How could I do otherwise!" As the eastern provinces were in turmoil, Zang Ba and the others upheld righteousness and pacified the region between Mount Tai and the Bohai Sea. None surpassed their achievements, and all were enfeoffed as [[Marquises|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]. Zang Ba became a [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]], and [[General Who Awes the Enemies|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-154]].

vern.zht: 臧霸又同於禁討伐昌豨，與夏侯淵討伐黃巾餘黨徐和等人，因有戰功，升任[[徐州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。[[沛國|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=26]]人武周任[[下邳|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.12209323&lng=117.9033062&name=Xiapi]]縣令，臧霸敬重武周，親自前往縣令的官舍拜訪他。有位[[部從事|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-021]]急躁而不守法，武周取得了他的罪證，便把他逮捕拷問後處死，臧霸因此更加看重武周。後來隨從征討孫權，率先登城，再次進入[[巢湖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=276]]，攻打[[居巢|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]，將其攻破。

passages.en: Zang Ba also joined Yu Jin in campaigning against Chang Xi, and Xiahou Yuan in campaigning against Xu He and other Yellow Turban remnants. For his achievements he was [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Xu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]. At the time, Wu Zhou of [[Pei State|/maps/map-overall?admin=26]] served as Prefect of [[Xiapi|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.12209323&lng=117.9033062&name=Xiapi]]. Zang Ba respected and admired Wu Zhou, and personally visited his residence. When a [[Regional Affairs Aide|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-021]] acted unlawfully and abused his authority, Wu Zhou uncovered his crimes, arrested him, and brought him to justice. Zang Ba held Zhou in even higher regard as a result. Zang Ba then joined the campaign against Sun Quan, taking the lead in the assault. He later advanced into [[Chao Lake|/maps/map-overall?water=276]], attacked [[Juchao|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]], and captured it.

orig.zht: 張遼之討陳蘭，霸別遣至[[皖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，討吳將韓當，使權不得救蘭。當遣兵逆霸，霸與戰於逢龍，當復遣兵邀霸於[[夾石|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]，與戰破之，還屯[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。權遣數萬人乘舩屯[[舒口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救蘭，聞霸軍在[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，遁還。霸夜追之，比明，行百餘里，邀賊前後擊之。賊窘急，不得上舩，赴水者甚衆。由是賊不得救蘭，遼遂破之。
orig.zhs: 张辽之讨陈兰，霸别遣至[[皖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，讨吴将韩当，使权不得救兰。当遣兵逆霸，霸与战于逢龙，当复遣兵邀霸于[[夹石|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]，与战破之，还屯[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。权遣数万人乘船屯[[舒口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救兰，闻霸军在[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，遁还。霸夜追之，比明，行百余里，邀贼前后击之。贼窘急，不得上船，赴水者甚众。由是贼不得救兰，辽遂破之。

vern.zht: 張遼討伐陳蘭時，臧霸被另派到[[皖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，討伐吳將韓當，使孫權不能救援陳蘭。韓當派兵迎擊臧霸，臧霸與他們在逢龍交戰；韓當又派兵在[[夾石|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]截擊臧霸，臧霸與他們交戰並將其擊敗，回軍駐紮在[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。孫權派數萬人乘船駐紮[[舒口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救援陳蘭，聽說臧霸的軍隊在[[舒|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，便逃了回去。臧霸連夜追擊，到天亮時已經行進一百多里，截住敵軍，前後夾擊他們。敵軍困窘危急，無法上船，跳入水中的人很多。因此敵軍無法救援陳蘭，張遼於是擊破了陳蘭。
vern.zhs: 张辽讨伐陈兰时，臧霸被另派到[[皖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]]，讨伐吴将韩当，使孙权不能救援陈兰。韩当派兵迎击臧霸，臧霸与他们在逢龙交战；韩当又派兵在[[夹石|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]截击臧霸，臧霸与他们交战并将其击败，回军驻扎在[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]。孙权派数万人乘船驻扎[[舒口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]]，分兵救援陈兰，听说臧霸的军队在[[舒|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]，便逃了回去。臧霸连夜追击，到天亮时已经行进一百多里，截住敌军，前后夹击他们。敌军困窘危急，无法上船，跳入水中的人很多。因此敌军无法救援陈兰，张辽于是击破了陈兰。

passages.en: When Zhang Liao campaigned against Chen Lan, Zang Ba was separately dispatched to [[Wan|/maps/map-overall?lat=30.62607288&lng=116.60310353&name=Wan]], to attack the Wu general Han Dang, so as to prevent Sun Quan from relieving Chen Lan. Han Dang sent troops to meet Zang Ba, and they fought at Fenglong. Han Dang again sent troops to intercept Zang Ba at [[Jiashi|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.24804329&lng=116.99614735&name=Jiashi]]. Zang Ba fought and defeated them there, then withdrew to garrison at [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]]. Sun Quan dispatched several tens of thousands of troops by boat to garrison at [[Shukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.53432438&lng=117.36806282&name=Shukou]], detaching a force to relieve Chen Lan. Upon hearing that Zang Ba's army was at [[Shu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.15710957&lng=117.26205139&name=Shu]], they retreated immediately. Zang Ba pursued through the night, and by dawn had marched over a hundred li, intercepting the enemy and striking them front and back. Pressed by the attacks, the enemy could not reach their boats, and many threw themselves into the water. Because of this the enemy could not relieve Chen Lan, and Zhang Liao went on to defeat him.

orig.zht: 霸從討孫權於[[濡須口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，與張遼為前鋒，行遇霖雨，大軍先及，水遂長，賊舩稍進，將士皆不安。遼欲去，霸止之曰：「公明於利鈍，寧肯捐吾等邪？」明日果有令。遼至，以語太祖。太祖善之，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[揚威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。後權乞降，太祖還，留霸與夏侯惇等屯[[居巢|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。
orig.zhs: 霸从讨孙权于[[濡须口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]，与张辽为前锋，行遇霖雨，大军先及，水遂长，贼船稍进，将士皆不安。辽欲去，霸止之曰：「公明于利钝，宁肯捐吾等邪？」明日果有令。辽至，以语太祖。太祖善之，[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[扬威将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。后权乞降，太祖还，留霸与夏侯惇等屯[[居巢|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。

vern.zht: 臧霸跟隨太祖到[[濡須口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]征討孫權，與張遼一起擔任前鋒。行軍途中遇上連綿大雨，大軍先到，水位隨即上漲，敵船漸漸逼近，將士們都很不安。張遼想要撤退，臧霸阻止他說：“曹公對利弊看得清楚，難道肯拋棄我們嗎？”第二天果然有命令下達。張遼到太祖那裏後，把這件事告訴了太祖。太祖很讚賞他，任命他爲[[揚威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。後來孫權請求投降，太祖回軍，留下臧霸和夏侯惇等人駐守[[居巢|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。
vern.zhs: 臧霸跟随太祖到[[濡须口|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]征讨孙权，与张辽一起担任前锋。行军途中遇上连绵大雨，大军先到，水位随即上涨，敌船渐渐逼近，将士们都很不安。张辽想要撤退，臧霸阻止他说：“曹公对利弊看得清楚，难道肯抛弃我们吗？”第二天果然有命令下达。张辽到太祖那里后，把这件事告诉了太祖。太祖很赞赏他，任命他为[[扬威将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]，[[假节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]。后来孙权请求投降，太祖回军，留下臧霸和夏侯惇等人驻守[[居巢|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]]。

passages.en: Zang Ba later joined the campaign against Sun Quan at [[Ruxukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]], serving as vanguard together with Zhang Liao. On the march, the army encountered continuous rain. After the main force arrived, the waters rose, and the enemy's boats gradually advanced, causing unease among the men. Zhang Liao wished to withdraw, but Zang Ba stopped him, saying, "His Excellency understands perfectly what is at stake. Why would he abandon us?" The next day, orders to retreat did indeed arrive. Zhang Liao then told Cao Cao of the conversation. Cao Cao praised Zang Ba, and [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] him [[General Who Promotes Might|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]], and [[Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]. Afterwards, when Sun Quan sought to surrender, Cao Cao withdrew, leaving Zang Ba together with Xiahou Dun and others to garrison at [[Juchao|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.62795047&lng=117.88668775&name=Juchao]].

orig.zht: 文帝即王位，[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]][[鎮東將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]]，進爵武安[[鄉侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]，[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]諸軍事。及踐阼，進封[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]，徙封[[良成|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]。與曹休討吳賊，破呂範於[[洞浦|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]]，[[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]為[[執金吾|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]]，位[[特進|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]。每有軍事，帝常咨訪焉。

vern.zht: 文帝即王位後，臧霸升任[[鎮東將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]]，進爵爲武安[[鄉侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]，[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]諸軍事。及至文帝登基，臧霸進封爲[[開陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]，又改封爲[[良成|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]][[侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]。臧霸與曹休一同討伐吳賊，在[[洞浦|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]]擊敗呂範，被徵召爲[[執金吾|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]]，加[[特進|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]之號。每當有軍事，文帝常向他諮詢請教。
vern.zhs: 文帝即王位后，臧霸升任[[镇东将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]]，进爵为武安[[乡侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]]，[[都督|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]诸军事。及至文帝登基，臧霸进封为[[开阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]][[侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]，又改封为[[良成|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]][[侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]]。臧霸与曹休一同讨伐吴贼，在[[洞浦|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]]击败吕范，被征召为[[执金吾|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]]，加[[特进|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]之号。每当有军事，文帝常向他咨询请教。

passages.en: When Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) succeeded as King of Wei, Zang Ba was [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[General Who Garrisons the East|/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-068]], advanced in rank to Wu'an [[Township Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-township-township-marquis]], the Township Marquis of Martial Pacification, and appointed as [[Commander|/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]] of all military affairs in [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]. When Cao Pi ascended the imperial throne, Zang Ba was further enfeoffed as [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]] of [[Kaiyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.1238282&lng=118.35003654&name=Kaiyang]], then reassigned as [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-county-marquis]] of [[Liangcheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.28604285&lng=118.02894911&name=Liangcheng]]. He joined Cao Xiu in campaigning against the Wu, defeating Lü Fan at [[Dongpu|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.64351707&lng=118.35843748&name=Dongpu]], and was [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] to the capital to become [[Bearer of the Golden Mace|/translations/officials/ministers#others-282]], ranked [[Specially Advanced|/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-118]]. Whenever military affairs arose, the Emperor regularly sought his counsel.

annotations.zht: 魏略曰：霸一名奴寇。孫觀名嬰子。吳敦名黯奴。尹禮名盧兒。建安二十四年，霸遣別軍在[[洛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]。會太祖崩，霸所部及[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，以為天下將亂，皆鳴鼓擅去。文帝即位，以曹休[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，霸謂休曰：「國家未肯聽霸耳！若假霸步騎萬人，必能橫行江表。」休言之於帝，帝疑霸軍前擅去，今意壯乃爾。遂東巡，因霸來朝而奪其兵。
annotations.zhs: 魏略曰：霸一名奴寇。孙观名婴子。吴敦名黯奴。尹礼名卢儿。建安二十四年，霸遣别军在[[洛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]。会太祖崩，霸所部及[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，以为天下将乱，皆鸣鼓擅去。文帝即位，以曹休[[都督|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]，霸谓休曰：「国家未肯听霸耳！若假霸步骑万人，必能横行江表。」休言之于帝，帝疑霸军前擅去，今意壮乃尔。遂东巡，因霸来朝而夺其兵。

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：霸又名奴寇，孫觀又名嬰子，吳敦又名黯奴，尹禮又名盧兒。建安二十四年，臧霸派遣一支分遣部隊駐紮在[[洛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]陽。恰逢太祖去世，臧霸所率領的部隊以及[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，認爲天下將要大亂，都敲着鼓擅自離去。文帝即位後，任命曹休[[都督|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]州的軍事。臧霸對曹休說：“朝廷只是不肯聽從我的建議罷了，如果能給我一萬步騎兵，我必定能在長江以南縱橫馳騁。”曹休將此事告知皇帝，皇帝因臧霸的軍隊之前擅自離去有所懷疑，又看他如今竟然還如此意氣豪壯。於是東巡，並趁着臧霸前來朝見，奪取了他的兵權。
vern.zhs: 《魏略》记载：霸又名奴寇，孙观又名婴子，吴敦又名黯奴，尹礼又名卢儿。建安二十四年，臧霸派遣一支分遣部队驻扎在[[洛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]阳。恰逢太祖去世，臧霸所率领的部队以及[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]兵，认为天下将要大乱，都敲着鼓擅自离去。文帝即位后，任命曹休[[都督|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]][[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]州的军事。臧霸对曹休说：“朝廷只是不肯听从我的建议罢了，如果能给我一万步骑兵，我必定能在长江以南纵横驰骋。”曹休将此事告知皇帝，皇帝因臧霸的军队之前擅自离去有所怀疑，又看他如今竟然还如此意气豪壮。于是东巡，并趁着臧霸前来朝见，夺取了他的兵权。

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Zang Ba's other name was Nukou. Sun Guan's other name was Yingzi. Wu Dun's other name was Annu. Yin Li's other name was Lu'er. In the 24th year of Jian'an, Zang Ba sent a detached force stationed at [[Luoyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]. When Cao Cao died, Zang Ba's own troops together with the [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] soldiery, believing the realm was about to fall into chaos, all beat their drums and departed without orders. When Cao Pi ascended the throne, he had Cao Xiu serve as [[Commander|/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-027]] over [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]] provinces. Zang Ba said to Cao Xiu, "The court has simply not been willing to entrust me! If I were given ten thousand infantry and cavalry, I could certainly sweep across the Yangtze frontier." Cao Xiu reported this to the Emperor. The Emperor had long been suspicious of Zang Ba for previously withdrawing his army without orders. Now, seeing that he remained as bold as ever, the emperor made an eastern tour and, when Zang Ba came to court, stripped him of his command.

orig.zht: 明帝即位，增邑五百，并前三千五百戶。薨，謚曰威侯。子艾嗣。艾官至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、[[少府|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]。艾薨，謚曰恭侯。子權嗣。霸前後有功，封子三人[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]，賜一人爵[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]。

vern.zht: 明帝即位後，給臧霸增加食邑五百戶，加上以前的一共三千五百戶。臧霸去世，諡號爲威侯。他的兒子臧艾繼承爵位。臧艾官至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、[[少府|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]。臧艾去世，諡號爲恭侯。他的兒子臧權繼承爵位。臧霸先後有功，朝廷封他的三個兒子爲[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]，賜給一個兒子[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]的爵位。

passages.en: When Cao Rui (posthumously honoured as Emperor Ming, the Radiant Emperor) ascended the throne, Zang Ba's fief was increased by five hundred households, bringing his total to three thousand five hundred. When Zang Ba died, he was posthumously honoured as Marquis Wei, the Formidable Marquis. His son Zang Ai succeeded him. Zang Ai eventually rose in office to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Minister of the Lesser Treasury|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]. When Zang Ai died, he was posthumously honoured as Marquis Gong, the Deferential Marquis. Zang Ai's son Zang Quan succeeded him. Across his career Zang Ba had rendered such service that three of his sons were enfeoffed as [[Marquises|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]], and one was granted the rank of [[Marquis Within the Passes|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]].

annotations.zht: 魏書曰：艾少以才理稱，為[[黃門郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，歷位[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。霸一子舜，字太伯，晉[[散騎常侍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，見武帝百官名。此百官名，不知誰所撰也，皆有題目，稱舜「才頴條暢，識贊時宜」也。
annotations.zhs: 魏书曰：艾少以才理称，为[[黄门郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，历位[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。霸一子舜，字太伯，晋[[散骑常侍|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，见武帝百官名。此百官名，不知谁所撰也，皆有题目，称舜「才颖条畅，识赞时宜」也。

vern.zht: 《魏書》記載：臧艾年少時就以才能和處理政務的能力受到稱讚，擔任過[[黃門郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，還先後擔任過多個郡的[[郡守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。臧霸有一個兒子叫臧舜，字太伯，擔任晉朝的[[散騎常侍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，在《武帝百官名》中有記載。這本《百官名》，不知道是誰撰寫的，裏面每個人名下都有評語，其中稱讚臧舜才能出衆、條理清晰，見識符合時宜。
vern.zhs: 《魏书》记载：臧艾年少时就以才能和处理政务的能力受到称赞，担任过[[黄门郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]，还先后担任过多个郡的[[郡守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。臧霸有一个儿子叫臧舜，字太伯，担任晋朝的[[散骑常侍|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]，在《武帝百官名》中有记载。这本《百官名》，不知道是谁撰写的，里面每个人名下都有评语，其中称赞臧舜才能出众、条理清晰，见识符合时宜。

annotations.en: The Book of Wei states: Zang Ai, while young, was praised for his talent and judgement. He became [[Gentleman within the Yellow Gates|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]], and served successively as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of various commanderies. Zang Ba had another son, Zang Shun, courtesy name Taibo, who under the Jin became [[Cavalier Regular Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-013]]. This is mentioned in the book Wudi Baiguanming, The Register of Officials under Emperor Wu. The author of this book is unknown. Each entry in the book carries a heading, and Zang Shun's states that he was "Exceptionally talented, clear-minded, and discerning in the affairs of the age."

orig.zht: 而孫觀亦至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，[[假節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]，從太祖討孫權，戰被創，薨。子毓嗣，亦至[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。

passages.en: Sun Guan likewise rose to become [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]], and [[Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally|/translations/officials#glossary-provisional-bearer-of-the-imperial-tally]]. He followed Cao Cao in campaigning against Sun Quan, was wounded in battle, and died. His son Sun Yu succeeded him, and likewise rose to become [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]].

vern.zht: 《魏書》記載：孫觀，字仲臺，是[[泰山|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=33]]人。孫觀和臧霸一同起兵，討伐黃巾軍，被任命爲[[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]。太祖擊敗呂布後，派臧霸去招降孫觀兄弟，對他們都給予了優厚的待遇。孫觀和臧霸一起征戰討伐，作戰時孫觀常常作爲先鋒衝鋒陷陣。孫觀征討平定[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]州的各路賊寇，功勞僅次於臧霸，被封爲呂都[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。康也憑藉功勞被封爲列侯。孫觀與太祖在[[南皮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]]會合，派遣子弟到[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]地居住，太祖任命孫觀爲[[偏將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]]，升任他爲[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]。後來他跟隨太祖到[[濡須口|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]]征討孫權，被授予假節。作戰時，他被飛箭射中，傷到了左腳，卻奮力作戰而不顧惜自身。太祖慰勞他說：“將軍受的傷非常嚴重，卻打得更加勇猛，難道不應該爲國家愛惜自己的身體嗎？”孫觀轉任爲[[振威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]。之後傷勢加重，最終去世。

annotations.en: The Book of Wei states: Sun Guan, courtesy name Zhongtai, was from [[Taishan|/maps/map-overall?admin=33]]. He rose up together with Zang Ba, campaigning against the Yellow Turbans, and was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]. When Cao Cao defeated Lü Bu, he had Zang Ba summon Sun Guan and his brothers, and treated them all generously. Fighting alongside Zang Ba in every campaign, Sun Guan was always at the forefront of the assaults. In pacifying the various rebel bands of [[Qing|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]] and [[Xu|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]] provinces, his achievements ranked just below Zang Ba's, and he was enfeoffed as Lüdu [[Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]. Sun Kang was likewise enfeoffed as a Marquis for his achievements. When he met with Cao Cao at [[Nanpi|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.0926547&lng=116.68045911&name=Nanpi]], Sun Guan sent his younger kin to reside at [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]], and was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Adjunct General|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-164]], later [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]. He followed the campaign against Sun Quan at [[Ruxukou|/maps/map-overall?lat=31.2019282&lng=117.97307792&name=Ruxukou]], and was made Provisional Bearer of the Imperial Tally. During the campaign against Sun Quan, he was struck by a stray arrow that severely wounded his left foot. Yet he fought on relentlessly. Cao Cao commended him, saying, "General, your wound is grievous, yet your fighting spirit only grows fiercer. Should you not also cherish yourself for the sake of the state?" He was [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to [[General Who Rallies Might|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-137]]. Later his wound worsened, and he died.
